first.text:
It's just the label for the next version of your program. Every time your program changes, it gets a new number. The first was the one we adopted on 1 November, the second and third were the two changes since, and this incline-curl addition would be the fourth. It's bookkeeping I shouldn't have put in front of you; the only thing it tells you is that this is a small revision of the same program, not a new one, and the block you're in carries on.

Nothing has been recorded yet. Do you want me to go ahead and add the incline curls to Monday?
